description.value:
Normalized BBTTCC ancestry. This item keeps the original species UUID while fitting the ancestry-root layer of the new identity stack.

Echo-Diver. The end of the world culled everything that couldn’t feel it coming. You felt it coming. You were not the biggest, not the strongest, not the smartest—you just always knew, a half-second before everyone else, which doorway was about to collapse and which corpse still had something in its pocket. The Shattering made a world where that half-second was the only currency that mattered.

“The lions are gone. The wolves are gone. The kings are gone. We’re still here. Think about what that means.”

Echo-Divers are the rats of the new world—and they say that with pride. A rat survives what a lion can’t. A rat is already moving when the ceiling falls. A rat threads a collapsing vault without ever touching a trigger plate. When everything went sideways, the creatures with the best time sense inherited Bad Eden.

Echo-Diver Core (Time-Sense)

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Ability Scores. Your background determines your ability score increases; Echo-Diver does not grant any ability score bonuses.

Temporal Flinch. You experience the next two seconds as a constant, faint pre-echo. You cannot be surprised while conscious, and once per short rest, when you or a creature within 10 feet of you would be hit by an attack you can see, you can use your reaction to move yourself or that creature 5 feet—if this moves the target out of the attack’s range or line, the attack misses.

Niche Survivor. You need roughly half the food, water, and air that a comparable Medium creature needs. You have advantage on Constitution saves against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, and extreme temperature. You can squeeze through gaps and hold stillness that shouldn’t work, and you know it.

Vault Sight. Darkvision 60 feet. You have advantage on checks to notice unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failures, and Spark/chronoflux residue.

Your Echo-Diver heritage grants additional features through advancements (Temporal Afterimage, Strategic Hooks) at character creation.
